"To quash the Criminal Proceeding of the Crime no 503/2013, F.I.R. No 473/2013 (
State vs Sudhir Mishra and others ), relating to the Case Crime No 503/2013, F.I.R.

Chief Judicial Magistrate VI, District - Lucknow as well as the Charge Sheet dated 23/10/2014 filed therein."
